screens.title: Qontext raises $2.7M to build the context layer for AI
screens.claim: Company announcement dated 5 February 2026: Berlin, $2.7M pre-seed led by HV Capital, founders Lorenz Hieber and Nikita Kowalski; production adoption is company-reported. Bounded broader and company-domain financing searches located no newer primary round. Search cannot exclude undisclosed financing; similar-name Kontext results were excluded.

screens.title: Qontext quickstart
screens.claim: Documents importing context, native source connectors, file maintenance, and agent access through MCP/API. Documentation is evidence of the offered integration path, not an executed integration or governance benchmark.

screens.title: About Qontext
screens.claim: Current team page names Lorenz Hieber CEO and Nikita Kowalski CPTO; historical funding page uses CTO. Prior role-specific founder-market fit not established by the reviewed material.

screens.title: SuperBryn Raises $1.2 Million in Pre-seed Round
screens.claim: Original investor announcement is dated 10 December 2025 and confirms $1.2M pre-seed. Names Nikkitha Shanker and Neethu Mariam Joy and reports prior operating/research experience. Early customer/design-partner claims are interested-party statements. No newer primary financing located in bounded searches.

screens.title: 2025: A Year of Builders, Breakthroughs, and Belief
screens.claim: 23 December 2025 newsletter repeats SuperBryn's $1.2M pre-seed; follow-through link leads to original 10 December announcement. Recap is not a second round.

screens.title: SuperBryn evaluation, observability and roadmap
screens.claim: Advertises evaluations and root-cause analysis; explicitly marks self-learning and multi-model routing as coming soon. Customer names, integrations, monitoring and compliance representations are company claims. No platform use, compliance audit or customer-side outcome validation performed.

screens.title: SuperBryn hiring at its Bengaluru office
screens.claim: Company-authored post explicitly states Bengaluru office. Supports operating location, not legal or global headquarters; relative posting age is not converted to an invented exact date.

screens.title: Neurofin Raises $1.6M Seed Round Led by UNLEASH Capital
screens.claim: Company page dated 10 July 2025 identifies Bengaluru HQ, $1.6M seed and founder Vijay Makhijani. Named institutions and processing outcomes are company claims; FY26 revenue figure is a target. Bounded financing refresh located no newer primary announcement; exact transaction closing date remains unverified.

screens.title: Neurofin document intelligence, customer references and team
screens.claim: Current site specifies first-time-right document processing, displays customer logos and a Muthoot testimonial, and reports founder banking/fintech experience. Company-hosted Tata Capital earnings-call quotation has not been traced to the issuer's transcript or attributed wholly to Neurofin; customer-side verification remains outstanding. Quantitative site metrics are not adopted as verified outcomes.

journal.title: Seedcamp: FAQs
journal.claim: Seedcamp says it considers companies from pre-product and pre-revenue through post-launch, and emphasizes founder problem understanding and action. Used as attributed fund criteria, not a universal venture rule.

journal.title: Bessemer: Part IV: Ten principles for building strong vertical AI businesses
journal.claim: The framework emphasizes customer preferences about automation, integrated workflows and quantifiable ROI. Applied to pilot design as analysis; portfolio anecdotes and aggregate margin claims are not repeated as independent evidence.

journal.title: Anthropic: Demystifying evals for AI agents
journal.claim: Distinguishes transcripts from resulting environment state; recommends balanced behavior tests, early concrete evaluation tasks and inspection of graders. Supports evaluation design, not validation of any screened company's product.

journal.title: Sequoia: Own Your Intelligence: A How-To Guide
journal.claim: Discusses cost, speed and proprietary data as possible motivations for controlling more of the stack; explicitly says frontier APIs and agents remain appropriate for many workloads. Total-cost comparison in the draft is original analysis.

journal.title: Letta: Introduction to Stateful Agents
journal.claim: Documents persisted agent state and editable memory blocks that can be shared between agents. Legacy V1 SDK documentation establishes an implementation pattern only; no commercial superiority or benchmark claim is inferred.

journal.title: LangGraph: Persistence
journal.claim: Documents checkpointers for thread-scoped graph state and stores for cross-thread data. Supports the existence of framework-level substitutes for separately purchased memory infrastructure.

journal.title: LangGraph: Interrupts
journal.claim: Documents pausing execution for external input, persisting state and resuming execution. Used as an implementation example of human intervention; no claim is made about low review cost.

journal.title: Intercom: Fin AI Agent outcomes
journal.claim: Defines confirmed and assumed resolutions, billable configured Procedure handoffs and deductions when a customer reopens the same conversation seeking further help. Supports scrutiny of contractual outcome definitions, not an independent assertion of customer value.

journal.title: Qontext raises $2.7M to build the context layer for AI
journal.claim: Company announcement dated 5 February 2026 identifies Lorenz Hieber and Nikita Kowalski, describes a $2.7M pre-seed and positions an independent reusable context layer. Production and performance statements remain company claims. This historical announcement is not a verification of current financing stage.

journal.title: Supermemory: Documentation introduction
journal.claim: Read as background on the product category; not used for a substantive claim in the final drafts. The inaccessible memory-engine route was not treated as evidence.

journal.title: Stripe: Record usage for billing with the API
journal.claim: Read as background on metering and duplicate-event prevention; not cited as evidence of task quality or included in the final article arguments.

journal.title: Qontext: Solving concurrency issues for parallel AI agents
journal.claim: Opened during research as a follow-up engineering source; no technical or commercial claim in the drafts relies on this article.
